entries.zh: 跟随少年；追捕逃亡的少年僮仆
entries.en: to follow the boy; to chase the runaway servant-lad

entries.zh: 追赶；追逐逃跑之人
entries.en: to chase; to pursue one who flees

entries.zh: 随起随倒，一起一落相续；西语词头又作分两路而行、各行其道
entries.en: to rise and fall in succession; (per headword) to go by two different roads, part ways
entries.notes: 汉字栏「随起随倒」与词头（分两路而行）语义不合，且M栏末音 xo/ho 有[疑]，两说并存待考

entries.zh: 听凭发落，依命而行；服从
entries.en: to submit to whatever is ordered; to obey

entries.zh: 顺着他的乖巧（机巧、狡黠）行事
entries.en: to follow his cunning; act as his craft and ingenuity direct

entries.zh: 随意，随心所欲、任意而行
entries.en: to follow one's own will; do as one pleases

entries.zh: 循规蹈矩，遵循规矩、依章程行事
entries.en: to follow the rule and walk by it; to conform to the rules
entries.notes: M栏第二行小字残损难辨（[残]），释义仅据汉字栏四字与西语词头，残行内容未采

entries.zh: 亚——次、第二；居次位、亚于前者
entries.en: second in order; next, inferior to the first

entries.zh: 二——序数第二；亦作数目二
entries.en: second; two

entries.zh: 亚魁——科举考试中名列第二者，次于魁首
entries.en: second-ranking graduate in the examinations; runner-up to the top place

entries.zh: 榜眼——殿试一甲第二名，位居状元之次
entries.en: second place in the palace examination, next after the top graduate

entries.zh: 亚圣——才德亚于至圣者；特指孟子
entries.en: the Second Sage, i.e. Mencius, next to Confucius

entries.zh: 第二——序次居二，位次第二
entries.en: the second; second in rank or dignity

entries.zh: 再、又；第二次（原稿借「各」字记此义，非「各个」）
entries.en: again, a second time; the character serves here as a phonetic loan, not 'each'
entries.notes: 汉字栏「各」本义「各个」，与词头「segunda vez（第二次）」不直合，判读依赖原稿以「各」记闽南语「again」义的用法推断

entries.zh: 当——妥当、稳当可靠；（又）典当、以物作抵
entries.en: secure, dependable, just right; also pawned, pledged as security
entries.notes: M栏音记污损难辨（T99），单字「当」义项繁多，词义仅据词头「seguro」与汉字栏推断

entries.zh: 停——停妥、安定，事情办定
entries.en: settled, fixed, at rest and secure

entries.zh: 稳——安稳无扰，稳妥可靠
entries.en: steady and secure; safe, free from molestation
entries.notes: M栏首音 un/on 存疑（[疑]），且音记两音节而汉字栏仅一字，或原为「稳当」义

entries.zh: 停当——停妥了当，稳妥办定
entries.en: settled and secure; firm, properly done

entries.zh: 的当——的确妥当，确切可靠
entries.en: exact and certain; precisely right, reliable
entries.notes: M栏多出一音节 ciao 无对应汉字，四栏未完全互证

entries.zh: 确当——确实妥当，确切不移
entries.en: certain and fitting; sure, exactly right
entries.notes: M栏多出一音节 coy 无对应汉字，四栏未完全互证

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 通栏附注首行残损、缩写连写难辨（仅辨 seguro、fin acabado 等字样），第二行小字几不可辨，无法成条释义
